class.name: SteamGameNotifications
class.description: Available from [method SteamPublisher.game_notifications] in trusted backend builds. Keep one canonical verified [SteamIdentity] per authenticated game launch and coordinate launch deduplication across workers. Writes require a [SteamNotificationStore]. Operation keys use up to 128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, periods, or colons. The service accepts up to 16 recipients per session and 8 KiB of encoded request JSON. Steam controls notification delivery.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an app-owned session from verified participants. Reuse the same immutable operation key to replay an accepted, committed response.

method.name: details
method.description: Requests one exact session owned by this app in the trusted store.

method.name: remove
method.description: Removes an owned session and its notifications through a durable operation. A repeated committed key returns the original acknowledgment.

method.name: request_opt_in
method.description: Requests Steam registration once per verified account and authoritative backend launch ID. Reuse [param launch_id] across authentication refreshes within a launch and issue a fresh ID on the next game launch. Use 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, periods, or colons. A missing ID returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A claimed launch returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE], including after an ambiguous Steam reply. Implement the launch claim hooks in [SteamNotificationStore]. A true receipt means Steam accepted registration. Steam controls the opt-in prompt and decision.

method.name: sessions_for
method.description: Reads up to 128 sessions returned for a user verified by this exact publisher and app.

method.name: update
method.description: Replaces the full participant state of an owned session. Supply all users who should remain in the session and a stable operation key. The creation context remains as it was.
